sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 460. Success value 100. 3x physical damage (Dark).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies. Applies blessing (recovers 50 Cost, increases max HP by 100%, nullifies status ailments and Unison Gauge reduction effects, reduces cooldown times by 50%, and recovers 20% of max HP every 5 seconds) for 60 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies Redoubt for 90 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; [Special] reduces physical/magic damage by 50%; nullifies fixed damage; nullifies special status ailments; nullifies status ailments. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
Only [Miracle of the Starry Night] Chron can be used as Unlocking Potential material
